title: festuca rubra var. tenuifolia
intro: Festuca rubra var. tenuifolia, commonly known as Red Fescue or Tall Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to Europe and Asia and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra var. tenuifolia include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
